dateline: BTS closed three sold-out La Plata nights (Oct 21, 23, 24) of the ARIRANG World Tour; São Paulo shows at Estádio MorumBIS were scheduled for Oct 28, 30 and 31, with no post-show reports verified yet for the opener.
heroHeadline: Day 4,886: BTS in São Paulo for ARIRANG World Tour
heroSubtitle: October 29, 2026 is Day 4,886 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. After three La Plata nights, the ARIRANG World Tour began its São Paulo leg on October 28, with further dates on October 30 and 31; the October 30 show is slated for cinema live viewing.
